_comment: Registry of Niimbot printer models and label sizes. w_px = printhead axis (width), h_px = feed axis (length). `task` selects the print-task variant in niimbot.js: "v4" (D110M/B1 Pro/B21 Pro) or "b1" (B1/B21/M2-H) — task is the protocol sequence, independent of dpi (B1 is 203 dpi, M2-H is 300 dpi, both task "b1"). `dpi` pairs a size with its model(s). `id` = printer model id for auto-detection. Entries marked `_untested` are derived from niimbluelib but not validated on hardware.

m2h._untested: Niimbot M2-H — same b1 print task as the B1 but 300 dpi (printhead 567 px). Derived from niimbluelib (model id 4608). NOT validated on hardware: confirm the BLE name prefix (guessed 'M2'; if it doesn't appear in the chooser, clear name_prefixes to list all Niimbot devices) and the real label pixel sizes.
m2h.label: Niimbot M2-H (untested)

T50x30_m2h._untested: M2-H 50×30 @ 300 dpi. w_px = printhead width (567 ≈ 48 mm, so a 50 mm label keeps a ~2 mm right margin, like the B1); h_px = 30 mm × 11.81. Verify on hardware.
T50x30_m2h.label: 50 × 30 mm (M2-H)
